items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: I did some recordings with him. ... Paul Shaffer was the leader and Will Lee playing bass.

ctx.x: Yeah. Were you with his band at the time or was that just —

No, no, it was just for the recordings. I did some recordings with him. I did some in New York and some in L.A. And Paul Shaffer was the leader and Will Lee playing bass. It was great, great players. But yeah that was some in New York and some out in L.A. And originally it started out where he wanted Copacabana to be like a Latin thing. Barry was at the piano, usually at the piano, and he’d start singing Copa Cobana [hums “Copacabana”] you know, he’s singing. And I don’t know it’s like this, it’s like that. And…
Do you recall like thinking oh this is going to be a hit?
